plan.title: Hallmark pathway GSEA on psoriasis DE results
plan.analytical_narrative: The differential expression (DESeq2, 6 psoriasis lesional 'treated' vs 6 control skin) is already delivered as de_results.csv (12,000 genes x 8 columns), so the question 'which hallmark pathways change' reduces to a gene-set enrichment analysis of the delivered contrast statistics rather than a re-run of DE. The plan ranks all genes by the DESeq2 Wald statistic (signed, so both directions are testable), runs fgsea against the staged MSigDB 2026.1 human hallmark collection (h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt, 50 HALLMARK_* sets in HGNC symbols), and reports normalized enrichment scores, adjusted p-values and leading-edge genes with enrichment plots. Because the data context flags sample_01 with a ~4x-below-median library size, a second track independently recomputes the DESeq2 contrast from the raw Salmon counts (counts.csv, 12,000 x 13) and re-runs the same hallmark enrichment on the recomputed ranking, quantifying how much the low-depth sample shifts both gene-level and pathway-level calls. Both tracks end in a small, comparable results table (pathway, NES, padj, leading edge) for the primary and sensitivity analyses.
